newsitem.title: UK: Reckitt appoints global supply director.
newsitem.headline: Reckitt appoints global supply director.

text.p: Consumer products group Reckitt & Colman said on Tuesday that it had appointed Alfred J. Battaglia as group director of its global supply division.
Battaglia, an American, would be responsible to ensure effectiveness of Reckitt's global supply chain which covers procurement of raw materials, packaging and manufacturing finished products.
Battaglia was earlier the group president and chief information officer of Becton Dickinson & Company.
He would be based in London and would report to chief executive Vernon L. Sankey.
